summary: Mitesco filed an 8-K reporting a $25,000 face 10% OID convertible bridge note (ZSP Capital) convertible at $0.15, plus 2,000,000 restricted shares issued at $0.0375 to four consultants, leaving roughly 51 million shares outstanding; Director Dr. Jordan Ballencic resigned October 8, 2026 citing limited time, disclosed alongside the financing and share issuances. No advisor, board recommendation, premium, or closing date was stated in the excerpt, and the filing is a routine small-cap funding and board-departure disclosure rather than a special-situation transaction.
